note: ADR 1216 slice 3: an async optimistic setter run by a seeded Map/Set forEach, or stored once in a fresh local Map, Set or WeakMap and handed back and called on the creating pass: Chrome throws OPTIMISTIC_WRITE_BEFORE_LOAD and SC2009 is a violation. An empty Set, a deleted entry, a store never run, a run before the store and another WeakMap key do not run the setter and stay uncertifiable.
